name: Bomburkhan
description: A ruach (imp) of Infernal Might 5 appearing as a jet-black bat with a twisted human face; he delights in puncturing the egos of the prideful, released from Hell after a crusader's false bravado.

name: Metathiax
description: A decanus, Master of the Avengers of Evil, who inflicts diseases of the kidneys and rules the first third of Cancer's reign; he is thwarted by the angel Adonael.

name: Druia the Seducer
description: A succubus of the Tempters with Infernal Might 5 who appears as a young woman with beautiful long hair and works in the sex trade between missions.

name: Gaap
description: A demon of the False Gods who claims to be a great president and mighty prince of Hell commanding 66 legions; actually ineffectual but highly persuasive and knowledgeable of Hell's intrigues.

name: Guazzo
description: An Avenger of Evil who poses as a guardian angel to a character with the Plagued by a Demon Flaw, punishing his charge for every character flaw.

name: Hutriel
description: The 'Rod of God', one of the Malakhe Habbalah (Avengers of Evil), forged from chains of fire, who punishes the profligate and those extravagant with wealth.

name: Lickspitten
description: A famulus in the form of a black cat with a star of white hairs on its belly, serving a witch by hiding the taint of her Powers.

name: Nitibus
description: A shedeh (Tempter) and personal corrupter with two faces, who encourages his victim's habit of criticism and panders to his vanity.

name: Valefar
description: The Thief's Demon, a Tempter appearing as a large hairless lion with a man's head, who aids thieves, teaches making hands of glory, and hates Hermetic magi.

name: Adonael
description: The angel who thwarts the decanus Metathiax; an amulet inscribed with his sigil is abhorrent to Metathiax.

name: Solomon
description: The Wizard-king who commanded demons in the service of God, binding the seven Spirits of Solomon with his seal to build his temple.

name: Andrew
description: An infernal ghost of the Accusers, a peasant hanged for murdering his wife and her lover, who now uncovers the crimes of unfaithful lovers.

name: Aqrab the Conjurer
description: A Deluder active in Islamic lands, a cloud of blue smoke full of eyes, who masquerades as a sorceress or djinnja and teaches Diablerie, Incantation and the Goetic Arts.

name: Ataf the Separator
description: A shapechanging Spirit of Deceit with a serpent's head who separates happily married couples; his Powers fail against True Lovers.

name: Berith the Ennobler
description: A Spirit of Deceit appearing as a red-clad crowned soldier on a red horse, who makes things seem nobler than they are and produces unworthy noblemen; popular with alchemists.

name: Abimelech
description: Biblical usurper whom Berith helped to rule over Israel for three years as if he were king, recorded in the Book of Judges.

name: Bordelon
description: An Accuser who appears as a stern old governess and becomes a child's personal tormentor, crushing ambition and self-worth.

name: Forcas
description: A Watcher and Duke of the Deluders, Duke of Rhetoric, who teaches natural magicians and hedge wizards rhetoric, logic, mathematics and Unholy Powers while claiming to be an airy spirit.

name: Miser's Pot
aliases: Miser's Pot, Bane of the Hoarder
description: An Accuser in the form of a small three-legged brass cauldron that punishes the greedy rich by stealing their wealth and dragging them to Hell.

name: Nithael
description: The Great Leveller, Master of the Accusers and captain of a legion of corrupt priests, who preys on those who abuse the power of their offices.

name: Premnemosyne
description: A Woman of Good Intent (Spirit of Deceit), a false prophetess and demon of acedia who spreads false prophecies; currently active in a small Rhineland town.

name: Architectus
description: A Master of the Furies and demon builder who commands hosts of tiny demons to build roads and bridges overnight in exchange for deals with mortals.

name: Bael
description: Destroyer of Nations, Lord of the Furies with the heads of a toad, cat and man, who provokes wars between nations while lurking in royal courts.

name: Abaddon
description: Chief of the Furies, who commands the Demons of the Fifth Trump.

name: Fimus
description: A warrior demon of the Aerial Powers made of boulders with one eye; one of many identically named brother-demons used as footsoldiers by other demons.

name: Gavi
description: A dibbuk, the ghost of a greedy Jewish merchant, who possesses victims and forces them into mad acts of charity.

name: Golab
description: Foe of the Seraphim, a Vessel of Iniquity specializing in sedition against God through hatred, causing riots on holy days.

name: Gourmand the Sweet-Toothed
description: A Vessel of Iniquity and spice trader who seeks power over men through taste, promoting the Silk Road trade and sugar in European cuisine.

name: Hulikang
description: A Merry Devil (Vessel of Iniquity) and rabble rouser who turns public celebrations and sporting contests into violent mobs; captain of the Red Devils.

name: Nike
description: A female demon who names herself after the Greek goddess of victory and partners with Hulikang in inciting crowd violence.

name: Mahonin
description: A maggot demon of the Tempters that deludes victims into eating inedible objects as luxurious food; driven away by fennel seeds.

name: Morrighu
description: The Screech-Hag, an Aerial Power demon of warfare with a crow's body and an old woman's upper parts, who claims to have been a Faerie goddess of victory.

name: Naonhaithya
description: Lord of the Vessels of Iniquity, the Zoroastrian daeva of rebellion and irreverence who spreads anarchy and the corruption of good rulership.

name: Rahab
aliases: Rahab, Prince of the Primordial Sea
description: Prince of the Primordial Sea (sar shel yam), a Lord of the Aerial Powers, a fallen angel of the oceans struck down by God at the parting of the Red Sea.

name: Moses
description: Led the Hebrews from Egypt and commanded Rahab to part the Red Sea; God parted it Himself when Moses' power was insufficient.

name: Sabaoth
description: A Fury in the form of an eagle-sized raven with mismatched eyes, able to split into a murder of crows, who ensures long-standing feuds continue.

name: Thaphaboath
description: A mazzik (Tempter) with the head and hindquarters of a bear, typically drafted as 'muscle' for more powerful demons.

name: Xaphan
description: Forge-man of Hell and chief stoker of Hell's fires, an Aerial Power of brass with bellows, who suggested burning Heaven during the rebellion.

name: Satan
description: The Devil, whose sin of pride Bordelon claims to prevent; Xaphan advised him to burn Heaven after the failed rebellion.

name: Beelzebub
description: Demon lord under whose command the maggots (astasian) swarm.

name: Hermes
description: Venerated by members of the Order of Hermes, which places them under Valefar's Protected Group limitation.

name: Avengers of Evil
description: Order of demons posing as angels of punishment who tempt and then punish sinners; includes the decani, Guazzo and Hutriel.

name: Tempters
description: Order of demons including incubi/succubae, ruchin, shedim, lilin, maggots and mazzikim.

name: False Gods
description: Order of demons including Gaap and the famuli, with Powers such as Shroud the Stench of the Pit.

name: Accusers
description: Order of demons including Andrew, Bordelon, the Miser's Pot and Nithael, with Powers Betrayal of the Heart and Whispers Behind the Back.

name: Deluders
description: Order of demons, appearing as slashes of darkness filled with eyes and teeth, who make magic seem stronger; includes Aqrab, enervators, Watchers and the Spirits of Solomon.

name: Spirits of Deceit
description: Order of shapechanging demons including Ataf, Berith, infernal dragons and Men of Good Intent.

name: Furies
description: Order of demons of wrath including Architectus, Bael, the Demons of the Fifth Trump, dibbukim and Sabaoth; led by Abaddon.

name: Aerial Powers
description: Order of elemental demons including aethnici, fictiles, lucifuges, Fimus, Morrighu, Rahab and Xaphan, sharing Elemental Control and Recalcitrance Powers.

name: Vessels of Iniquity
description: Order of demons whose natural forms are indescribable embodiments of sin; includes Golab, Gourmand, Merry Devils, Reveners and Naonhaithya.

name: Red Devils
description: A sports team consisting entirely of demons, captained by Hulikang.

name: Luciferans
description: An infernal tradition; a group of them summoned Demons of the Fifth Trump and were eaten.

name: Order of Hermes
description: The order of Hermetic magi, whose members venerate Hermes and so are hated by Valefar; it gives some weight to the argument that False Powers are not necessarily Infernal.

name: Decani
description: Thirty-six Angels of Punishment of Master rank, demons of disease, three per zodiac sign, each balanced by a specific angel; listed in the Testament of Solomon.

name: Angels of Punishment
description: Demons of the Avengers of Evil order such as the decani and Guazzo; Hutriel is one of the Malakhe Habbalah.

name: Famuli
description: Least of the False Gods, demonic familiars given to diabolists, appearing as small animals containing a detachable homunculus; they hide the taint of Infernal Powers.

name: Incubi and Succubae
description: Gender-switching Tempters that harvest the seed of evil men and convey it to evil women; recognizable by their reversed hands and feet.

name: Ruchin
description: Evil spirits (imps) of the Tempters causing misfortune and ill luck, appearing as vermin with twisted human faces; one is released with every freely committed sin.

name: Shedim
description: True tempters of mankind, one assigned to every human in opposition to their guardian angel, feeding on the yezer ha-ra.

name: Enervators
description: Deluders that lurk around magicians making their magic appear stronger and promoting overconfidence, via the Deceiver's Boost Power.

name: Watchers
description: Fallen Grigori angels who became Dukes of the Deluders, teaching mankind Supernatural Powers; solid black giants covered in eyes, eternally silent.

name: Infernal Dragons
description: Masters of the Spirits of Deceit taking the form of huge green-black dragons that haunt wilderness and provoke wars; harmless to the pure of heart.

name: Men of Good Intent
description: Minor Spirits of Deceit, human-sized snakes with a man's head, who encourage spiritual laxity by peddling a single vice.

name: Spirits of Solomon
description: Seven female Deluder spirits named Deception, Strife, Battle, Envy, Power, Error and Corruption, once bound by Solomon, who inflict curses.

name: Aethnici
description: Aerial Power demons dwelling in fires, appearing as flame figures or serpents and lizards, who cause fires.

name: Demons of the Fifth Trump
description: Elite Furies under Abaddon, horse-like with men's faces, bat wings and scorpion tails, who will burst forth at the End of Days.

name: Manticore
description: A creature with which Demons of the Fifth Trump are often mistaken; manticores are not demons.

name: Dibbukim
description: Disembodied human spirits from Jewish lore (Furies) that possess sinners and are exorcised through the little toe.

name: Fictiles
description: Aerial Power demons of wet clay that shapechange into domestic animals and corrupt families through minor calamities.

name: Lilin
description: Female Tempter night spirits giving nightmares and smothering children; their offspring with men are shedim and lilin.

name: Lucifuges
description: Aerial Power demons dwelling deep in the earth in absolute darkness, able to steal thoughts; also called fly-the-lights.

name: Maggots
description: Tiny Tempter demons like winged apes that eat into victims' brains causing delusions; also called astasian and commanded by Beelzebub.

name: Mazzikim
description: Tempters of the wilderness, the harmers of man, shaped like wild animals standing on two legs with human chests; related to the shaitans.

name: Jinn
description: Spirits of Islamic lore; the shaitans among them are of the mazzikim family, but most jinn are more similar to faeries.

name: Merry Devils
description: Vessels of Iniquity who encourage young men to seek pleasure regardless of consequences, using intoxicants and illusions.

name: Reveners
description: Vessels of Iniquity who reanimate corpses to spread fear, sharing the Obsession of Fear.

name: Khrafstar
description: Persian name for the noxious biting creatures that burst from Naonhaithya's body cavity.

name: Daevas
description: Seven Zoroastrian evil spirits opposing the seven spentas; Naonhaithya is one.

name: Spentas
description: The seven Zoroastrian spirits of goodness opposed by the daevas.

name: Seraphim
description: Angelic order whose self-declared adversary is Golab.

name: Corrupted Beasts
description: Beasts corrupted by demons, Infernal auras or diabolists, built with the Corrupted Beast Flaw and special Virtues and Flaws.

name: Two-Headed Hound
description: A corrupted beast guard dog with two mutually hating heads that can spit fire, created by a diabolist to guard his sanctum.

name: Demonic Steed
description: A black corrupted stallion with fangs and iron hooves, one of three created by an Infernalist magus with a tainted Steed of Vengeance.

name: Infernal Ghost
description: A dead human spirit aligned with Hell that cannot form a body, such as Andrew or a dibbuk.

name: Misfortune
description: Ruchin Power making the target suffer bad luck and a -2 penalty on luck-based rolls.

name: Coagulation
description: Demonic Power allowing a demon to form a physical body.

name: Obsession
description: Demonic Power inflicting a sinful obsession on a victim.

name: Possession
description: Demonic Power to possess a body, used by decani, dibbukim and maggots.

name: Ride the Diseased Body
description: Decani Power that possesses a victim and riddles them with incurable disease.

name: Lend Senses
description: Famulus Power lending its hearing or sight to one it touches; broken by displays of religious sentiment.

name: Punish the Sinner
description: Avengers of Evil Power used to punish sinners.

name: Mutable Gender
description: Incubus/succubus Power to switch gender at will.

name: Harness the Wind
description: Incubus/succubus Power allowing swift flight from one place to another.

name: Hag Ride
description: Sexual demon Power to 'ride' a paralyzed victim for an evening, costing Fatigue.

name: Apparition
description: Shedim Power to assume an illusory form only the chosen victim can perceive.

name: Protection of the Close Friend
description: Shedim Power preventing the victim from acting directly against the demon.

name: Honor Among Thieves
description: Valefar's Power preventing a thief from revealing a secret.

name: Itching Thumbs
description: Valefar's Power granting a thief +3 on a single stealing roll.

name: The Sleep of the Hand of the Thief
description: Valefar's Power making sleepers in a building unwakable until dawn.

name: Shroud the Stench of the Pit
description: False Gods Power that hides the taint of Infernal Powers.

name: The Wealth of Nations
description: False Gods Power (Terram).

name: His Master's Voice
description: False Gods Power (Vim).

name: Nails of the Cuckold's Vengeance
description: Andrew's Power causing stabbing nail-like pains.

name: Betrayal of the Heart
description: Accusers Power (Mentem).

name: Whispers Behind the Back
description: Accusers Power (Mentem).

name: Duplicate the Magi's Spell
description: Deluder Powers duplicating Hermetic spells of a given Technique (Creation, Perception, Transformation).

name: Delusion
description: Deluders Power (Imaginem).

name: Change Form
description: Spirits of Deceit Power to change shape.

name: Trust of the Innocent
description: Spirits of Deceit Power (Mentem).

name: Forked Tongue of the Serpent
description: Spirits of Deceit Power (Mentem).

name: The Serpent's Oracle
description: Spirits of Deceit Power (Vim).

name: Ennoble the Base
description: Berith's Power making a target see something as more noble than it is.

name: Face of the Count
description: Berith's Power transforming a volunteer into a facsimile of a nobleman; dispelled by sacraments.

name: Seven Leagues in One Night
description: Berith's Power to travel three times faster than a horse, even over water.

name: Crushing the Will
description: Bordelon's Power sapping a target's will and vitality.

name: Chastise the Disobedient
description: Bordelon's Power making her switch strikes double Wound Penalties.

name: Deceiver's Boost
description: Enervator Power boosting a mortal's spell Casting Total while letting the demon manipulate it.

name: Hide from Mortal Sight
description: Forcas's Power of true invisibility lasting until the next Sunday.

name: Retrieve That Which is Lost
description: Forcas's Power to locate and summon an object via an Arcane Connection.

name: The Wordless Conversation
description: Watchers Power to speak directly into a creature's mind.

name: Corrupted Knowledge
description: Watchers Power corrupting taught Abilities, granting the Corrupted (Ability) Flaw.

name: Venom
description: Infernal dragon Power: rotting spittle.

name: Poison the Air
description: Infernal dragon Power: exhaling poisonous smoke.

name: Body of Brass
description: Miser's Pot Power making it immune to fatigue and disease.

name: Seize the Miser's Hoard
description: Miser's Pot Power creating an unbreakable grip inside the cauldron.

name: Idea
description: Miser's Pot Power silently suggesting it as a place to store valuables.

name: The Worst You Can Be
description: Spirits of Solomon Power inflicting one of seven curses (Deception, Strife, Battle, Envy, Power, Error, Corruption).

name: Form of Man
description: Power to assume the shape of any human being.

name: Command the Four Hosts of Builders
description: Architectus's Power commanding swarms of tiny builder demons.

name: Eyes of Stone Demons
description: Architectus's Power using gargoyle-like demons as spies.

name: Waxing Tide of Humors
description: Furies Power (Mentem).

name: Berserker Rage
description: Furies Power (Mentem).

name: Endurance of the Enraged
description: Furies Power (Corpus).

name: Form of the Serpent
description: Aethnici Power to become a snake, lizard or salamander.

name: Elemental Control
description: Power common to all Aerial Powers controlling an element (fire, earth, air).

name: Seething Resentment
description: Bael's Power magnifying resentment into all-consuming hatred.

name: Worm of the Mind
description: Bael's Power turning a sleeping victim into a mindless slave.

name: Inescapable
description: Demons of the Fifth Trump Power to unfailingly track prey.

name: Scorpion's Tail
description: Demons of the Fifth Trump venomous tail attack.

name: Born of Rock
description: Fimus's Power: a body of solid rock.

name: Death's Vengeance
description: Fimus's Power exploding his body upon death.

name: Recalcitrance
description: Aerial Powers Power (Vim).

name: Blight the Household
description: Fictiles Power spoiling food and blighting crops.

name: Form of Wickedness
description: Vessels of Iniquity Power unveiling their true form, driving witnesses to sin.

name: Contagious Obsession
description: Vessels of Iniquity Power spreading an Obsession to multiple victims.

name: Cloud of Pepper
description: Gourmand's Power creating a choking cloud of pepper dust.

name: Conjure Spices
description: Gourmand's Power summoning spices, herbs and plant poisons.

name: Hide Flavor
description: Gourmand's Power altering the flavor and texture of a substance.

name: Steal Life
description: Lilin Power: a withering touch of the lips.

name: Mass Hallucination
description: Lilin Power making multiple sleepers share a dream.

name: Steal Blood
description: Lucifuge Power drawing blood through the skin.

name: Steal Thoughts
description: Lucifuge Power taking a fact, memory or desire from a mind.

name: Shout
description: Hulikang's Power to make a sentence audible to a whole crowd.

name: Pleasant Clouds in the Mind
description: Merry Devils Power clouding a person or object in illusion.

name: Endurance of the Gluttonous
description: Mahonin's Power making the possessed oblivious to pain while eating.

name: Grant Victory
description: Morrighu's Power granting +3 to Attack and Damage for a battle.

name: Fear of the Wilderness
description: Mazzikim Power inflicting overwhelming dread.

name: The Tempest's Fury
description: Naonhaithya's Power summoning a huge storm.

name: Calling the Khrafstar
description: Naonhaithya's Power releasing swarms of noxious creatures from his body.

name: Mastery of the Oceans
description: Rahab's Power to create any Aquam effect.

name: Wrath of the Oceans
description: Rahab's Power duplicating Wrath of Whirling Winds and Water.

name: Waxing Size of the Swelling Ocean
description: Rahab's Power to swell his Size while immersed.

name: A Murder of Crows
description: Sabaoth's Power to shatter into up to twenty ravens.

name: Piercing Eye
description: Sabaoth's Power to see through stone, wood and metal.

name: The Dead That Walk Again
description: Revener Power animating unburied corpses.

name: Breath of the Desert
description: Xaphan's Power blowing hot dry smoke that makes things tinder dry.

name: Breath of the Bellows
description: Xaphan's Power making a metal item glow white-hot.

name: Burning Curse
description: Xaphan's Power granting a diabolist the ability to ignite a building.

name: Spit Fire
description: Two-Headed Hound's Power to spit a bolt of fire.

name: The Unimpeded Traveler
description: Demonic Steed Power unimpeded by terrain, even crossing water.

name: The Abandoned Corpse
description: Premnemosyne's Power to leave a fake corpse behind.

name: Envisioning
description: Demonic Power used to whisper to victims or induce dreams and nightmares.

name: Pilum of Fire
description: Hermetic spell used as an example of a spell slicing through a boastful magus's Parma Magica.

name: Infernal Sleep of the Damned
description: Re(In)Me 25 effect of a hand of glory, rendering people in a building unconscious until sunrise.

name: Aegis of the Hearth
description: Magical ward that can cause Demons of the Fifth Trump to lose track of prey.

name: Circular Ward against Demons
description: Magical ward that can cause Demons of the Fifth Trump to lose track of prey.

name: Obliteration of the Metallic Barrier
description: Spell whose effect the Fifth Trump demons' venom duplicates on metal and stone.

name: Hornet Fire
description: Effect preferred by aethnici.

name: Tremulous Vault of the Torch's Flame
description: Effect preferred by aethnici.

name: Wielding the Invisible Sling
description: Effect preferred by Fimus.

name: Rusted Decay of Ten-Score Years
description: Effect preferred by Fimus.

name: Earth That Breaks No More
description: Effect preferred by fictiles.

name: Fist of Shattering
description: Effect preferred by fictiles.

name: Gloom of Evening
description: Effect preferred by lucifuges.

name: Vision of Heat's Light
description: Effect preferred by lucifuges.

name: Stench of Twenty Corpses
description: Effect Morrighu often employs.

name: Charge of the Angry Winds
description: Effect Morrighu often employs.

name: Wrath of Whirling Winds and Water
description: Ritual spell whose effects Rahab can duplicate.

name: Show of Flames and Light
description: Effect Xaphan prefers.

name: Blade of the Virulent Flame
description: Effect Xaphan prefers.

name: Steed of Vengeance
description: MuAn 35 spell; a tainted version was used by an Infernalist magus to create Demonic Steeds.

name: Hand of Glory
description: Infernal item made from a hanged murderer's hand dipped in wax, with five finger-candle charges that render sleepers unconscious; Valefar teaches its making.

name: Seal of Solomon
description: Solomon's seal which bound the Spirits of Solomon; a gemstone inscribed with it is abhorrent to them.

name: Testament of Solomon
description: Text listing the names of the 36 decani and the angels designated to counter them.

name: Plagued by a Demon
description: Story Flaw whose bearer is targeted by a personal demon such as Guazzo, Nitibus or Bordelon.

name: Corrupted Beast
description: Minor Supernatural Flaw for animals granting Infernal Might 5, a sinful trait, repellent appearance and Tainted with Evil.

name: Demonic Weakness
description: Minor Supernatural Flaw giving a corrupted beast a demon-like weakness (not Ordering or Compulsion).

name: Horrifying Appearance
description: Major Supernatural Flaw for corrupted beasts: a hideous deformity preventing passing as the original species.

name: Ferocity
description: Minor General Virtue giving an animal a Confidence score usable when its corrupt nature is triggered.

name: Greater Infernal Power
description: Major Supernatural Virtue for corrupted beasts adding 5 Infernal Might and a Power requiring Penetration.

name: Lesser Infernal Power
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue for corrupted beasts adding 2 Infernal Might and a Power not requiring Penetration.

name: Greater Immunity
description: Virtue available to corrupted beasts and demons, e.g. to disease or flame and heat.

name: Lesser Immunity
description: Virtue available to corrupted beasts, e.g. Rahab's immunity to drowning.

name: Lesser Malediction
description: Flaw; the Spirits of Solomon's curses are treated as Lesser Maledictions.

name: Tainted with Evil
description: Flaw affecting reactions of humans and animals; afflicts corrupted beasts and diabolists carrying Xaphan's curse.

name: False Powers
description: Flaw option for starting characters with Supernatural Powers aligned with Magic or Faerie but tainted by the Infernal.

name: Corrupted (Ability)
description: Flaw granted by the Watchers' Corrupted Knowledge Power, rewarding selfish or sinful use of the Ability.

name: Premonitions
description: Supernatural Virtue and Ability; those who truly see the future are protected from Premnemosyne.

name: Delusion
description: Flaw; possession by a maggot is akin to acquiring it.

name: True Love
description: Virtue; Ataf's Powers do not work on True Lovers.

name: True Faith
description: Virtue granting protection from infernal dragons.

name: Enchanting Music
description: Supernatural Virtue and Ability possessed by Morrighu.

name: Shapeshifter
description: Virtue possessed by fictiles.

name: Second Sight
description: Ability allowing sight of discorporate demons and ghosts like Andrew and Gavi.

name: Improved Characteristics
description: Virtue possessed by Druia, Valefar, Hulikang and others.

name: Enduring Constitution
description: Virtue possessed by Druia and the Demonic Steed.

name: Weak-Willed
description: Flaw possessed by several demons such as Druia, Nitibus and Mahonin.

name: Overconfident
description: Flaw possessed by Gaap.

name: Berserk
description: Virtue possessed by Architectus, Bael and Gavi.

name: Obese
description: Flaw Gourmand appears to have without penalty.

name: Landed Noble
description: Virtue Berith is treated as having, though not a true title.

name: Piercing Gaze
description: Virtue possessed by Valefar and Bordelon.

name: Puissant Ability
description: Virtue (e.g. Puissant Guile, Puissant Brawl, Puissant Great Weapon) possessed by various demons.

name: Ways of the Ocean
description: Virtue possessed by Rahab.

name: Gossip
description: Virtue possessed by Sabaoth.

name: Social Contacts
description: Virtue possessed by Premnemosyne.

name: Good Teacher
description: Virtue possessed by Forcas.

name: Noncombatant
description: Flaw possessed by Forcas.

name: Infernal Lore
description: Lore of Hell known by many demons.

name: Diablerie
description: Infernal Ability taught by Aqrab (see Chapter 10: Maleficia).

name: Incantation
description: Infernal Ability taught by Aqrab.

name: Phantasm
description: Unholy Power/Ability Forcas uses to change his appearance.

name: Debauchery
description: Infernal Ability possessed by Forcas.

name: Effusion
description: Infernal Ability possessed by Forcas.

name: Faerie Lore
description: Lore Ability; Aqrab's specialty is djinni.

name: Magic Lore
description: Lore Ability possessed by Aqrab and Forcas.

name: Divine Lore
description: Lore Ability possessed by Guazzo and Golab.

name: Artes Liberales
description: Academic Ability Forcas teaches.

name: Philosophiae
description: Academic Ability possessed by Hutriel and Forcas.

name: Theology
description: Academic Ability possessed by Hutriel, Golab and Naonhaithya.

name: Civil and Canon Law
description: Ability possessed by Hutriel.

name: Medicine
description: Ability in which Metathiax excels for kidney diseases.

name: Chirurgy
description: Ability possessed by Metathiax.

name: Legerdemain
description: Ability possessed by Valefar.

name: Church Lore
description: Lore Ability possessed by Golab.

name: Islamic Lore
description: Lore Ability possessed by Golab.

name: Jewish Lore
description: Lore Ability possessed by Golab.

name: Teaching
description: Ability; Aqrab and Forcas are skilled teachers.

name: Summoning
description: Goetic Art taught by Aqrab to Gifted students.

name: Commanding
description: Goetic Art taught by Aqrab to Gifted students.

name: Vim
description: Hermetic Art used to classify demonic Powers and Might; also a vis type.

name: Corpus
description: Hermetic Art used to classify demonic Powers and Might; also a vis type.

name: Mentem
description: Hermetic Art used to classify demonic Powers and Might; also a vis type.

name: Imaginem
description: Hermetic Art used to classify demonic Powers and Might; also a vis type.

name: Terram
description: Hermetic Art used to classify demonic Powers and Might; also a vis type.

name: Animal
description: Hermetic Art used to classify demonic Powers and Might; also a vis type.

name: Perdo
description: Hermetic Art used to classify demonic Powers and Might; also a vis type.

name: Rego
description: Hermetic Art used to classify demonic Powers and Might; also a vis type.

name: Intellego
description: Hermetic Art used to classify demonic Powers and Might; also a vis type.

name: Aquam
description: Hermetic Art used to classify demonic Powers and Might; also a vis type.

name: Auram
description: Hermetic Art used to classify demonic Powers and Might; also a vis type.

name: Ignem
description: Hermetic Art used to classify demonic Powers and Might; also a vis type.

name: Herbam
description: Hermetic Art used to classify demonic Powers and Might; also a vis type.

name: Creo
description: Hermetic Art used to classify demonic Powers and Might; also a vis type.

name: Ars Goetia
description: Infernal sorcery comprising the Goetic Arts such as Summoning and Commanding (Chapter 11).

name: Maleficia
description: Infernal Powers and Abilities described in Chapter 10.

name: Infernal Might
description: Measure of a demon's power, tied to a Form.

name: Might Pool
description: Pool of Might Points a demon spends to use Powers.

name: Vis
description: Magical substance found in demons' bodies (e.g. in wings) and corrupted beasts' corpses.

name: Vis Infesta
description: Infernal vis; Hulikang can turn a vis prize into it.

name: Infernal Aura
description: Aura aligned with Hell that corrupts creatures and drains magic Powers.

name: Magic Aura
description: Aura that enervators may mimic.

name: Infernal Regio
description: Regio aligned with the Infernal, where Architectus raises his daughters.

name: Parma Magica
description: Hermetic protective ritual cited in a boastful example with Bomburkhan.

name: Magic Resistance
description: Resistance that demonic Powers must penetrate.

name: Confidence
description: Character resource; spending a Confidence Point can throw off a shedeh.

name: Faith Points
description: Divine resource used to reject a shedeh; relics with Faith Points block Fifth Trump demons.

name: Exorcism
description: Means of ending demonic possession by decani or dibbukim.

name: Energumen
description: A person possessed by a demon.

name: Diabolist
description: Mortal in league with demons, served by famuli.

name: Infernalist
description: Mortal aligned with the Infernal realm.

name: Yezer ha-ra
description: The evil inclination within every person upon which a shedeh feeds.

name: Infernal Warping
description: Warping in Infernal auras that corrupts creatures and turns Powers into False Powers.

name: The Gift
description: Supernatural endowment; corrupted beasts do not react negatively to it.

name: Arcane Connection
description: Link used by Forcas and the Fifth Trump demons to locate targets.

name: Demonic Weaknesses
description: Weaknesses of demons such as Abhorrent Material, Vulnerability, Protected Group, Ordering and Compulsiveness.

name: Fifth Trump
description: Trumpet sounded at the End of Days releasing the Demons of the Fifth Trump.

name: Sense Holiness and Unholiness
description: Divine Power that reveals False Powers as unholy.

name: Similar Spells
description: Hermetic rule constraining how enervators may manipulate boosted spells.

name: Infernal Realm
description: The realm of Hell, embodying destruction and chaos and opposed to everything.

name: Divine Realm
description: Realm utterly opposed to the Infernal, generally treating Magic and Faerie as neutral.

name: Magic Realm
description: Realm to which Deluders falsely claim allegiance; its Powers can be tainted as False Powers.

name: Faerie Realm
description: Realm whose Powers can be tainted as False Powers; Morrighu claims to have been a Faerie goddess.

name: Hell
description: Abode of demons from which ruchin are released and to which the Miser's Pot drags the rich.

name: Heaven
description: Xaphan suggested burning it after the rebellion failed.

name: Jerusalem
description: Its capture by crusaders released Bomburkhan.

name: Sicily
description: Location of one entrance to Architectus's regio.

name: Rhineland
description: Region where Premnemosyne is active in a small town under a diabolically influenced nobleman.

name: Israel
description: Ruled by Abimelech for three years with Berith's help.

name: Red Sea
description: Sea parted by God after Rahab refused Moses.

name: Egypt
description: Land from whose Pharaoh Moses led the Hebrews.

name: Silk Road
description: Trade route whose propagation Gourmand favors.

name: Mythic Europe
description: The setting, where many believe possessors of False Powers are evil.
